IPT.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/8] T2 assessments were set at the end of treatment for all participants. This did not control for duration, but it did ensure that assessment would come after the treatment—be it CBT or UC—had been given a full opportunity to produce effects.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/7] Assessments were carried out by interviewer pairs including one clinical psychology graduate student and one post-BA research assistant, both blind to condition.
